title: Freelance Web Developer / Designer
summary:
Worked independently with clients in Trinidad and internationally on web development, WordPress, graphic design, and other digital projects. Managed projects from initial requirements and design through development, revisions, deployment, and ongoing support.

Freelancing alongside other roles gave me experience working directly with clients, managing projects independently, adapting to different businesses and requirements, and taking responsibility for both the technical and visual sides of a project.
achievements: Built and maintained websites for local and international clients
Provided web development and graphic design services
Managed client communication, project requirements, revisions, launches, and ongoing website support
